title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026
requirement: Eligible landlords are allowed to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
coverage_conditions: eligible rental units under the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board
exemptions: tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025, and who had their rents set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act
quoted_span: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
